intro: Camp E'thok is a Galak centaur settlement located in northwestern Thousand Needles. The aggressive centaur tribe uses this canyon encampment as a base to stage ambushes against passing caravans traveling through the riverbed below.

p: Tucked into the rugged northwestern reaches of Thousand Needles, Camp E'thok serves as a key settlement for the hostile Galak centaur. Like their kin across Kalimdor, the Galak are relentlessly predatory, preying upon any travelers wandering into the canyon shadows. The camp is notorious for orchestrating raids against merchant caravans, notably ambushing the goblin Wizlo Bearingshiner and seizing his goods—though his prized gadget managed to slip beyond their grasp, guarded by his fierce pet panther.
